# Tonight (PinkPantheress song)
“Tonight” is a song by British singer-songwriter PinkPantheress. It was released on 4 April 2025 by Warner Records UK as the lead single from her second mixtape Fancy That. The track features lush string arrangements and a sleek, dance-oriented beat; OutNow magazine described it as a “playful, bass-driven anthem”. Lyrically, the song depicts the excitement of a late-night romantic encounter. “Tonight” peaked at number 35 on the UK Singles Chart. Its music video, directed by Charlotte Rutherford, shows PinkPantheress and her friends disrupting a formal Regency-era ballroom gathering, dancing freely and breaking with tradition.
## Background and release
PinkPantheress announced “Tonight” in early April 2025 as the first single from her upcoming mixtape Fancy That. The song was written and produced by PinkPantheress together with collaborators aksel arvid and Count Baldor. In announcing the song, she said she was “so excited to finally bring out the first single of [her] new project” and expressed hope that listeners would enjoy it. This single marked her first new solo release since “Turn It Up” in 2024. The track was released digitally on 4 April 2025 via Warner Records UK.
## Composition
Musically, “Tonight” opens with lush cinematic strings before transitioning into a sleek, bass-driven dance groove. OutNow noted the song’s “dance-ready groove” and PinkPantheress’s signature sweet-toned vocals with a flirtatious edge. The production balances elegance with energy, combining orchestral elements with a contemporary pop beat. Critics have observed that the lyrics focus on anticipation and excitement for an evening together, fitting the song’s hypnotic, late-night vibe.
## Music video
The official music video for “Tonight” was directed by Charlotte Rutherford. It is set in an opulent, grand mansion and portrays a formal Regency-era ballroom party. In the video, PinkPantheress and her crew crash the elegant gathering in period costumes (including corsets and powdered wigs) and begin dancing exuberantly. The visuals deliberately contrast the rigid formality of the setting with the vibrant, free-spirited dance and celebration that ensue.
## Chart performance
“Tonight” entered the UK Singles Chart in mid-April 2025 and reached a peak position of number 35. It remained on the chart for six weeks. (It also charted in other countries, reflecting its commercial reach beyond the UK.)

[PinkPantheress](https://djmag.com/news/pinkpantheress-song-doesnt-need-be-longer-two-minutes-30) is back with the video for her new single, ‘Tonight’, the first track to be lifted from her forthcoming mixtape, 'Fancy That'. Listen to it below.

‘Tonight’ was written and produced by PinkPantheress, alongside aksel arvid and Count Baldor. The video, directed by Charlotte Rutherford, plunges the bedroom pop star back into the regency era with powdered wigs, corsets and candlelit banquets. Speaking about the single, PinkPantheress commented: “I’m so excited to finally bring out the first single of my new project, i hope everyone has as much fun listening to it as i do”.

'Fancy That', the artist's second mixtape, will land on 9th May. The nine-track release features additional contributions from the likes of phil, Oscar Scheller and The Dare, and is described as a step into a "fun and kitsch-y era, rooted in British culture". It features samples of tracks by Panic! at the Disco, Jessica Simpson and Basement Jaxx.

Speaking about the mixtape, PinkPantheress said: “Announcing this tape marks a huge milestone for me as an artist, this feels like the most tied together project i’ve applied myself to as an artist and for my fans who have been with me for years, I hope they can hear the signs of growth in me as an artist.”

Pre-order/save it [here](https://pinkpantheress.lnk.to/FancyThat).

To celebrate the news of new release, PinkPantheress has also announced a two night residency at the O2 Academy in Brixton for later this year. She will play the iconic venue on 18th and 19th September. Those who pre-order ‘Fancy That’ via [this link](https://shop.pantheress.pink/) by 9th April at 5pm BST for will get access to exclusive pre-sale tickets, while general sale goes live 14th April at 10am BST via [this link.](https://www.pantheress.pink/)

This is PinkPantheress’ first new solo track since ‘[Turn It Up](https://djmag.com/news/pinkpantheress-song-doesnt-need-be-longer-two-minutes-30)’ last May and follows on from a recent appearance on ‘[True Religion](https://djmag.com/news/shygirl-enlists-isabella-lovestory-and-pinkpantheress-new-single-true-religion-listen)’ by ShyGirl and a feature on the ‘Mash-Up’ version of ‘CRAZY’ by LE SSERAFIM alongside Dashaun Wesley. She also appeared on Kaytranada’s ‘[TIMELESS](https://djmag.com/news/kaytranada-shares-new-album-timeless-featuring-channel-tres-pinkpantheress-more-listen)’ album, also released last year.

The new project will be her first since 2023’s ‘[Heaven Knows](https://djmag.com/news/pinkpantheress-releases-debut-album-heaven-knows-listen)’.

Listen to PinkPantheress’ appearance on [The Louis Theroux Podcast](https://djmag.com/news/listen-pinkpantheress-appearance-louis-theroux-podcast).

PinkPantheress Drops New Single “Tonight” With Ballroom-Inspired Visual
=======================================================================

by[Kelia](https://outnowmagazine.com/author/keliaauthor/)

April 7, 2025

![Image 19: PinkPantheress](https://i0.wp.com/outnowmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/PinkPantheress.jpg?fit=332%2C187&ssl=1) ![Image 20: PinkPantheress](https://i0.wp.com/outnowmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/PinkPantheress.jpg?fit=1044%2C588&ssl=1)

Photo Credit: Charlie Engham

[PinkPantheress](https://outnowmagazine.com/tag/pinkpantheress/) debuts her latest track [“Tonight,”](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IrEFKJnl1H8) a playful and hypnotic release via Warner Records UK.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Anti-pop artist and producer PinkPantheress returns with a seductive new single, “Tonight,” signaling a fresh chapter in her musical journey. Released via Warner Records UK, the track is a playful, bass-driven anthem brimming with energy and sensuality.

Co-produced by PinkPantheress, aksel arvid, and Count Baldor, “Tonight” opens with lush cinematic strings before transitioning into a sleek, dance-ready groove. The singer’s signature sweet-toned vocals take on a flirtatious edge as she glides through the track’s hypnotic rhythm, encouraging listeners to let go and give in to the moment.

“I’m so excited to finally bring out the first single of my new project, I hope everyone has as much fun listening to it as I do,” PinkPantheress shares.

[![Image 21](https://i0.wp.com/outnowmagazine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Untitled-200-x-200-px-1.png?w=1200&ssl=1)](https://artistsonmedia.com/get-featured-out-now-magazine/ "Ad Banner")

Advertisement

The accompanying music video, directed by Charlotte Rutherford, adds another layer to the experience. Set in a grand mansion, the visuals juxtapose rigid ballroom formality with vibrant self-expression. As PinkPantheress and her crew crash the elegant gathering, the vibe shifts, and the once-reserved guests follow suit—dancing freely, breaking tradition, and embracing joy.

“Tonight” presents PinkPantheress at her most confident, delivering a single that balances elegance with rebellious energy. It’s a track made for late nights, spontaneous moments, and fearless self-expression—an exciting preview of what’s to come from her next project.

With this release, PinkPantheress continues to reinvent her sound while maintaining the core of what makes her unique: playful lyricism, inventive production, and an unmistakable voice guiding it all.

===============================================================

*    [![Image 11: Picture of Quincy](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/db33ec44c695fdcad25658700d94d9083ee32b16ac624b1a3e1bb34eb85ff975?s=96&d=identicon&r=g)Quincy](https://ratingsgamemusic.com/author/quincydmnc/)

![Image 12](https://rgmnow.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/PinkPantheress-Tonight.png)

* * *

PinkPanthress is unbelievably unique (I’m not sure if that’s a compliment).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Guess who’s back? [PinkPantheress](https://rgmnow.com/?s=PinkPantheress)! The UK singer-producer, known for crafting viral hits, has returned to the music scene with her highly anticipated new single, “Tonight.” With multiple tracks surpassing 100 million streams on Spotify—and “Boy’s a Liar Pt. 2” inching toward a billion—expect “Tonight” to follow suit in racking up impressive numbers.

This time around, PinkPantheress delivers a bolder, more seductive vibe. “Tonight” explores the anticipation and excitement of a long-awaited romantic encounter. She candidly sings about receiving steamy late-night texts, packing her overnight bag, and getting ready for a night of passion with her special fling.

Staying true to her signature style, “Tonight” boasts an upbeat tempo, an irresistibly catchy chorus, and mesmerizing melodies. Her delicate, dreamy vocals add a sparkly, intoxicating charm to the track—making it a must-listen for fans and newcomers alike.

You don’t meet people like PinkPanthress daily.
